newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea buys dlrs at 891.50 to stop won rise.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea buys dlrs at 891.50 to stop won rise.

text.p: The Bank of Korea intervened on Friday afternoon, buying dollars at 891.50 won in spot trading to limit the won's rise against the dollar, dealers said.
Dealers also said the central bank bought dollars at 891.80 in value-tomorrow trading.
But they were unable to give the value of the central bank's purchase.
The dollar began to fall against the won in the local market with inflows of foreign funds, sparked by the foreign stockholding expansion.
Dealers said some $500 million to $600 million would come into the country by next week for stock investment.
The foreign stock ownership ceiling expanded to 23 percent today from 20 percent. --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5645
